# netactuate_nke_access_urls (Resource)

Manages a NKE Access Urls.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_nke_access_urls" "example" {
  cluster_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) NKE cluster ID for which access URLs are created.

### Read-Only

- `api` (String, Sensitive) Secure URL for Kubernetes API access.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `kubernetes_dashboard` (String, Sensitive) Secure URL for Kubernetes dashboard access.
- `prometheus` (String, Sensitive) Secure URL for Prometheus access.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_nke_access_urls.example 12345
```
